depiction.primary_object: three stacked horizontal linesrepresenting text or list items
modifiers: vertical double-headed arrow on the left
depiction.composition: side-by-side vertical arrow and three horizontal bars

readings.meaning: line spacing or line height adjustment
sort, reorder, or prioritize list items

ambiguity: Commonly serves dual duty in UI as either text line-spacing (in word processors) or list sorting/reordering (in task managers and tables).

modifier_semantics.modifier: vertical double-headed arrow on the left
modifier_semantics.meaning: vertical spacing, height, or up-and-down reordering

Double-space the entire manuscript and widen margins before sending it to the copy editor
Put the national parks wishlist in a sensible driving order from south to north
Go through the grocery list and rearrange items to match the store aisle layout
Rank the daycare waitlists in order of preference before calling them back on Thursday

reasoning: This is a standard UI toolbar glyph for text line-spacing or list sorting rather than a concrete real-world object or distinct life activity. For almost any task involving ranking, prioritizing, or formatting, an icon depicting the specific subject being ordered (a document, music playlist, shopping list, or backlog) is far more informative at a glance.
